pages.title: Send and receive Reticulum or MeshCore messages

Overview: Messages provides Reticulum/LXMF direct conversations and MeshCore companion direct/channel chat. APRS remains a receive view with local drafts.
Setup / example: In Connections, choose the matching service and attach its owner. In Messages press P to select the protocol, then O to connect. Select a contact, press V, and compare the full fingerprint or public key before confirming.
MeshCore requires a private meshcore-owner.toml and a separate runtime. See docs/messaging.md for installation and configuration.
Controls: C composes; Ctrl-S explicitly sends. Enter keeps the draft. Escape leaves the editor. Tab switches panes. D disconnects MeshCore.
Reticulum A publishes or hides messaging discovery. Publication requires confirmation. Discovery starts off.
Settings / defaults / storage: Drafts stay in memory per owner and conversation. Owners retain bounded binary message history. MeshCore serial is cleartext to the attached radio and requires explicit trusted_peripheral configuration.
Lifecycle: No radio connects or transmits chat at shell launch. Sent is not delivered. MeshCore direct acknowledgements confirm reception; channel sends provide no group receipt. Shared-key channels do not authenticate individual members.
Troubleshooting: Unconfirmed means delivery is unknown; review before resending. No route may require explicit Reticulum discovery. Hiding discovery cannot erase earlier announcements.
Both service endpoints must use binary wire version 2. MeshCore BLE and arbitrary Pocket services over MeshCore are not implemented. Physical MeshCore acceptance remains pending.
